parlays.title: Bought points · 4 legs
parlays.about: Buys points on alternate spreads and totals (or takes the moneyline) to make each leg more likely, while the parlay still pays at least even money. Every rung is priced by the model's margin and total distribution; rungs the book prices more than 8% under fair value are skipped. At the main lines these 4 legs would pay +2037 with a 5% chance; with the bought points it pays +157 with a 46% chance.
